cat > build.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from ase import Atoms
from ase.io import write
lig=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('Cc1cc(C)c(-n2ccn[c-]2)c(C)c1'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(lig,randomSeed=54)
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(lig,maxIters=2000)
p=np.array(lig.GetConformer().GetPositions())
org=(p[10]+p[9])/2
ex=(p[9]-p[10]);ex/=np.linalg.norm(ex)
ey=p[[6,7,8]].mean(0)-org;ey-=ey.dot(ex)*ex;ey/=np.linalg.norm(ey)
ez=np.cross(ex,ey)
q=(p-org)@np.array([ex,ey,ez]).T+np.array([0,1.47,0])
# Mesityl imidazol-2-yl bridges in opposite orientations.
ligq=[q,q@np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.])]
cod=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles('C1=CCCC=CCC1'))
AllChem.EmbedMolecule(cod,randomSeed=54)
conf=cod.GetConformer()
init=np.array([[-3.58,1.48,.67],[-3.58,1.48,-.67],[-4.52,.67,-1.32],[-4.52,-.67,-1.32],[-3.58,-1.48,-.67],[-3.58,-1.48,.67],[-4.52,-.67,1.32],[-4.52,.67,1.32]])
# Start COD heavy atoms in its chelating tub conformation, place H from local bond directions.
for i in range(8):conf.SetAtomPosition(i,init[i])
for i in range(8):
 a=cod.GetAtomWithIdx(i);hs=[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='H']; cs=[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors() if n.GetSymbol()=='C']
 b=[(init[j]-init[i])/np.linalg.norm(init[j]-init[i]) for j in cs]
 out=-(b[0]+b[1]);out/=np.linalg.norm(out)
 normal=np.cross(b[0],b[1]);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal)
 for t,h in enumerate(hs):
  v=out if len(hs)==1 else out*.577 + normal*(.816 if t==0 else -.816)
  conf.SetAtomPosition(h,init[i]+v*1.09)
ff=AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeForceField(cod,AllChem.MMFFGetMoleculeProperties(cod))
for i in [0,1,4,5]:ff.MMFFAddPositionConstraint(i,0.0,500.)
ff.Initialize();ff.Minimize(maxIts=2000)
c=np.array(conf.GetPositions())
syms=['Ir','Ir']
xyz=[[-2.1,0,0],[2.1,0,0]]
for m,co in [(lig,ligq[0]),(lig,ligq[1]),(cod,c),(cod,c@np.diag([-1.,-1.,1.]))]:
 syms.extend(a.GetSymbol() for a in m.GetAtoms());xyz.extend(co)
atoms=Atoms(syms,positions=xyz)
write('initial.xyz',atoms,format='xyz',comment='Ir2(mu-C,N-mesitylimidazolyl)2(cycloocta-1,5-diene)2; full hydrogens')
print('Atom count:',len(atoms))
print('C,N donor indices 0-based:',12,11,39,38)
print('COD olefin indices:',56,57,60,61,76,77,80,81)
PY
python build.py
OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 xtb initial.xyz --gfn 2 --chrg 0 --uhf 0 --opt tight > xtb.log 2>&1 & echo $! > xtb.pid
sleep 2; tail -15 xtb.log

mkdir -p constrained; python - <<'PY'
from ase.io import read
from rdkit import Chem
from pathlib import Path
ats=read('initial.xyz');
cons=[(0,1,4.0),(0,12,2.02),(0,38,2.12),(1,39,2.02),(1,11,2.12)]
for m,base in [(0,56),(1,76)]:
 for i in [0,1,4,5]:cons.append((m,base+i,2.2))
for smi,offset in [('Cc1cc(C)c(-n2ccn[c-]2)c(C)c1',2),('Cc1cc(C)c(-n2ccn[c-]2)c(C)c1',29),('C1=CCCC=CCC1',56),('C1=CCCC=CCC1',76)]:
 mol=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
 for b in mol.GetBonds():
  i=b.GetBeginAtomIdx()+offset;j=b.GetEndAtomIdx()+offset
  d=ats.get_distance(i,j)
  # prevent rearrangements/dissociation during metal optimization
  cons.append((i,j,d))
text='$constrain\n  force constant=0.5\n'+''.join(f'  distance: {i+1}, {j+1}, {d:.6f}\n' for i,j,d in cons)+'$end\n'
Path('constrained/control.inp').write_text(text)
print('Bond and coordination constraints:',len(cons))
PY
cd constrained; OMP_NUM_THREADS=4 xtb ../initial.xyz --gfn 2 --chrg 0 --uhf 0 --input control.inp --opt tight > run.log 2>&1 & echo $! > run.pid
sleep 2; tail -4 run.log

from ase.io import read
import numpy as np
from rdkit import Chem
ats=read('initial.xyz'); n=len(ats);excluded=set()
for smi,off in [('Cc1cc(C)c(-n2ccn[c-]2)c(C)c1',2),('Cc1cc(C)c(-n2ccn[c-]2)c(C)c1',29),('C1=CCCC=CCC1',56),('C1=CCCC=CCC1',76)]:
 mol=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi))
 for b in mol.GetBonds():excluded.add(tuple(sorted((off+b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),off+b.GetEndAtomIdx()))))
clashes=[]
for i in range(2,n):
 for j in range(i+1,n):
  if (i,j) in excluded:continue
  d=ats.get_distance(i,j)
  if d<1.25:clashes.append((i,ats[i].symbol,j,ats[j].symbol,d))
print('Initial clashes:',clashes)
PY
